docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Kālidāsa’s first play, the story of King Agnimitra and the exiled Mālavikā, in a literal English translation by Tawney (Calcutta, 1891). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Malavikagnimitra · C. H. Tawney · 1891, 140 scanned pages. Published 1891; Charles Henry Tawney died 1922; the play is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
